name: A failure after a fix is a bigger cuss than the first
case: The agent's tests fail, then pass, and then, a minute and a half later, the whole turn fails on an error anyway. That stings more than a first failure: Boop makes a grumpy, irritated or whiny face played as a failure, held twice or more, and says something about it. Its mood ends up put out: grumpy, irritated, annoyed, whiny or determined.
why: PERSONALITY: a failure is bigger than the win before it, and bigger again after other failures; the finish line says the failed check (after a failed check). characters/boop/steering/mood/: a failed turn moves the mood on toward grumpy
